body:
Uhm, this is a bit embarrassing, this has been on my TODO list for literal years but I was regularly distracted from fixing it by other stuff.

While you are at it, there are a bunch more places where godot messes up luminance calculations:

```
drivers/gles3/shaders/effect_blur.glsl#L285
drivers/gles3/shaders/effects/glow.glsl#L81
servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/effects/blur_raster.glsl#L136
servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/effects/copy.glsl#L193
servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/effects/luminance_reduce_raster.glsl#L56
servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/effects/luminance_reduce.glsl#L47
servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/environment/sdfgi_direct_light.glsl#L386
servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/environment/sdfgi_direct_light.glsl#L389
servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/forward_clustered/scene_forward_clustered.glsl#L2538
servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/forward_clustered/scene_forward_clustered.glsl#L2541
```

And maybe also:
`servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/environment/gi.glsl#L546`

If you could take a look at those lines listed above and address them in this PR it should also fix #57015

Thanks, its great that this has finally been fixed.
Took an in depth look just now, imo this is ready to be merged!

EDIT: If you want you can edit your initial comment and add "fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/57015". That should hopefully be enough for github to auto close the issue.
